mod.chinese_can_fly.name: Chinese Can Fly
tooltip.chinese_can_fly.character_rubbin: Taken from an ancient rock inscription
The words on these pages seem to recognize you.
Do you still remember how to fly?
It needs 15 bookshelves and the highest enchantment tier.
tooltip.chinese_can_fly.chinese_dictiona: It records lost words and an inexplicable power.
Only one who truly understands it may find the answer.
actionbar.chinese_can_fly.rubbing.wrong_: The inscription must be rubbed from its front face
actionbar.chinese_can_fly.rubbing.invali: This rock inscription cannot be rubbed
